Privacy Policy

Last updated: March 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how GROFAB TECHLABS PRIVATE LIMITED and its affiliates (collectively "GROFAB", "we", "our", "us") collect, use, share, protect or otherwise process your personal data through grofabwear.com (the "Platform"). By using the Platform, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy.

Information We Collect

We collect personal data when you register, browse, or transact on our Platform. This includes your name, email address, phone number, shipping address, payment details, and browsing behaviour. You always have the option to not provide certain information by choosing not to use a particular feature.

How We Use Your Data

  • To process and fulfil your orders
  • To personalise your shopping experience
  • To communicate order updates, offers, and promotions
  • To detect and prevent fraud or unauthorized activity
  • To improve our Platform, products, and services

Sharing Your Information

We may share your data with logistics partners, payment processors, and marketing affiliates to fulfil services. We may also disclose information to comply with legal obligations or protect against fraudulent activity. We do not sell your personal data.

Data Security

We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, disclosure, or misuse. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

Data Retention & Deletion

We retain your data only as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy. You may request deletion of your account and data by writing to us. Certain data may be retained for legal compliance purposes.

Your Rights

You may access, update, or correct your personal data through your account settings. You may withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time by contacting us.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Significant changes will be communicated via email or Platform notification.
